capabilities: Render pipe tables indented inside list items in Live Preview
Edit table cells inline via clicking, Enter saves, Escape cancels, Tab moves
Render Markdown and internal links inside table cells
Style tables with bold headers, hidden separator rows, and no-wrap rows
Force monospace font on table regions on Android
extras: Not reviewed by Obsidian staff per the manifest.
intentEvidence: Obsidian ignores indented tables and shows them as plain text, this plugin makes them readable without changing the markdown.
problem: Obsidian ignores pipe tables that are indented within list items and shows them as plain text, making them unreadable without reformatting the Markdown.
summary: Live Preview renderer that displays Markdown pipe tables indented inside list items, with inline cell editing, instead of plain text.
